statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient presents with exertional dyspnea
The patient has established atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is ordered
The study is ordered to assess cardiac rhythm over an extended period
The study is ordered to evaluate the correlation between symptoms and potential arrhythmic events
The claim was denied with reason code CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits rules indicating care may be covered by another payer
